enchantment.violas_wardrobe.buoyant.desc: Obtains a slow falling effect after falling for a certain distance.
enchantment.violas_wardrobe.charming.des: Slightly reduces the price when players trade with villagers.
enchantment.violas_wardrobe.light_footin: Reduces food level consumption caused by jumping and moving.
enchantment.violas_wardrobe.lumina.desc: Leaves starlight particle on the trajectory of skirt movement. There is a small probability that they will fall into a confused state, thus randomly changing their attack targets when attacking groups of monsters.
enchantment.violas_wardrobe.sweat_tracin: Helps bees nearby collect nectar and produce honey faster.
enchantment.violas_wardrobe.taming.desc: Improve the probability of success for players to tame animals.
